topic: What Sam Altman Really Thinks About the Future of Work

youtube.title: What Sam Altman Really Thinks About the Future of Work
youtube.description:
What Sam Altman really thinks about the future of work: he thinks AI will do the work, and people should get paid anyway.

In 2021 he wrote that thinking software takes the job and a capital tax should send everyone a check. Then the chatbot emptied the inbox. In 2023 he told the Senate some jobs vanish and better ones appear.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story.
